# H3 finite source vector

This manifest freezes the private source framing, finite two-source
wave, same-index materialization request, deterministic test order seed, and
deadline bounds exercised by the black-box process test owned by this
qualification profile.

Certificates, private keys, state roots, binaries, ports, and run evidence are
generated under the test temporary directory and never stored in Git. Passing
this vector proves only the controlled distribution fixture; it does
not select a public bootstrap or Route protocol.
